questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees in Germany receive per calendar year?

evidence.exact_text: Full-time employees whose contractual work location is Germany receive **30 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year**.

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees in Pakistan receive per calendar year?

evidence.exact_text: Full-time employees whose contractual work location is Pakistan receive **24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year**.

questions.question: How many unused annual-leave days may be carried forward, and by what date should they normally be used?
questions.expected_answer: A maximum of 5 unused annual-leave days may be carried forward, and they should normally be used by 31 March of the following year.

evidence.exact_text: Employees may carry forward a maximum of **5 unused annual-leave days** into the following calendar year.
Carried-forward leave must normally be used by **31 March** of the following year.

questions.question: How far in advance should leave of more than 5 consecutive working days normally be requested?

evidence.exact_text: Leave of **more than 5 consecutive working days** should normally be requested at least **3 weeks in advance**.

questions.question: Is annual-leave entitlement based on nationality or on contractual work location?
questions.expected_answer: It is based on the employee's contractual work location, not nationality, citizenship, or temporary work location.

evidence.exact_text: The annual entitlement is based on the employee's **contractual work location**, not nationality, citizenship, or the country from which the employee happens to work temporarily.

questions.question: Within how many calendar days should employees normally submit business-expense claims?

evidence.exact_text: Employees must normally submit business-expense claims within **30 calendar days** of the expense date.

questions.question: Above what euro amount is a receipt required for an individual expense?

evidence.exact_text: - **EUR 20** for expenses paid in euros;

questions.question: Which policy should employees use to check hotel room-rate limits?
questions.expected_answer: The current Business Travel Policy, HR-TRV-0173

evidence.exact_text: For hotel limits, employees must use the current **Business Travel Policy, HR-TRV-0173**.

questions.question: How many company-paid transition days may an eligible full-time employee with at least 12 months of continuous service receive?

evidence.exact_text: In addition to any statutory entitlement, eligible full-time employees who have completed at least **12 months of continuous service** may receive up to **5 company-paid transition days** associated with the birth or adoption of a child.

questions.question: For how long may an employee returning from parental leave request a temporary reduced-work schedule?

evidence.exact_text: An employee returning from parental leave may request a temporary reduced-work schedule for up to **8 weeks**.

questions.question: How many days per week may employees contracted in Germany normally work remotely?

evidence.exact_text: Employees contracted in Germany may normally work remotely for up to **3 days per week**, subject to manager approval and team scheduling.

questions.question: Is manager approval alone sufficient for cross-border remote work?
questions.expected_answer: No. Cross-border remote work requires prior written approval from both HR and the employee's manager.

evidence.exact_text: Cross-border remote work requires prior written approval from **both HR and the employee's manager** because tax, immigration, payroll, information-security, and employment-law requirements may apply.
Manager approval alone is not sufficient for cross-border remote work.

questions.question: For how long may a department director approve a temporary exception to the weekly office-attendance requirement?

evidence.exact_text: A department director may approve a temporary exception to the weekly office-attendance requirement for up to **4 consecutive weeks**.

evidence.exact_text: For flights with a scheduled duration of **more than 6 hours**, premium economy may be booked with manager approval.

questions.question: After parental leave, which policy governs remote work and how many remote days per week may a Germany-based employee normally have?
questions.expected_answer: Remote work must follow HR-RMT-0204, and a Germany-based employee may normally work remotely up to 3 days per week.

evidence.exact_text: Any remote-work arrangement must follow **Remote Work Policy HR-RMT-0204** unless a specific temporary exception is approved.
Employees contracted in Germany may normally work remotely for up to **3 days per week**, subject to manager approval and team scheduling.
